sophia (Support): FYI ACME reported a p99 jump after we onboarded maple-v2 yesterday. p95 also up. They say long-context requests (>8k tokens) are slow, from ~200ms median to ~1.4s p99.

sophia (Support): Repro link + request id: https://support.internal/acme/INC-5123 
Sample request id: req_20260315_8123

morgan (Eng-Infra): Do we have traces or token counts? any auth/billing errors accompanying this?

sophia (Support): Attached a small excerpt from logs: 
```
req=req_20260315_8123 model=maple-v2 prompt_tok=8921 response_tok=102 max_lat=1420ms kv_cache_hit=false
```
Seems kv_cache_hit flipped to false more often. Also tokenizer token count looks inflated compared to maple-v1 for the same prompt.

alok (Eng-ML): maple-v2 was rolled with the new "bpe-ext" tokenizer variant and we pushed a small normalization change last night. Could be causing token inflation. Any concrete token count diffs?

sophia (Support): Yes. Same prompt tokenized: maple-v1 -> ~6200 tokens; maple-v2 -> ~8921 tokens (sampled). ~40% inflation. Customer ran a batch of their long prompts and saw p99 spikes coincide with inflated counts.

jenna (SRE): If token count increases, that increases KV cache footprint and sequence length affecting kernel path. Are batcher decisions different for these long requests? Any correlation with batch size >1?

morgan (Eng-Infra): Metrics: KV cache eviction rate on maple-v2 pool rose from 5% -> 45% during the spike window. Also observed higher memory churn and occasional host GC when many inflated requests hit the same shard. Batcher avg size didn't rise, but the time to service increased due to longer decode paths.

alok (Eng-ML): Immediate mitigations I propose: 1) Pin ACME to maple-v1-legacy tokenizer variant (server-side routing), 2) temporarily cap max_input_tokens for maple-v2 to 8192, 3) rollback normalization diff in tokenizer if we confirm root cause. Can we canary any of these?

sophia (Support): I already offered pin + cap to ACME and they accepted the pin to v1 for now. Staging repro steps below if you want to replicate: 
```
# repro curl
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -d '{"model":"maple-v2","input": "<long prompt ~10k chars>", "stream": false}'
```
Reproduced locally with same prompt yields token counts above.

jenna (SRE): Pushing a quick hotfix to batching policy: prefer smaller batches for requests with detected long-token inputs, and increase KV cache retention TTL on maple-v2 shard pool to reduce churn. Deploying to subset (5%) now.

morgan (Eng-Infra): Rolling out TTL bump + per-model max_kv_cache_size increase for maple-v2. Also added a transient alert rule for token inflation >25% vs baseline.

infra-bot: deploy-notice: batcher-policy-hotfix -> prod (maple-v2 pool) completed 2m ago :white_check_mark:

alok (Eng-ML): I opened PR #4521 to tweak BPE merge heuristics and added a tokenizer regression test that compares token counts vs v1 on our benchmark prompt set. Also adding a change to emit token_count delta in trace spans.

sophia (Support): I'll keep ACME updated — told them we pinned to v1 and rolled batching + TTL fixes. Monitoring p95/p99 for 24 hours. If numbers don't improve we'll rollback the maple-v2 tokenizer change entirely.

jenn(a typo?) (SRE): (typo-nit) actually that's me, jenna. I'll watch infra metrics and escalate if KV eviction doesn't drop.

alok (Eng-ML): Follow-ups: run a perf sweep for long-context on maple-v2 after PR lands, and add a canary that routes 1% traffic with token inflation protection.

sophia (Support): Closing notes: customer mitigation accepted, staging repro + logs attached to INC-5123, owners: alok (tokenizer PR), morgan (KV/infra), jenna (SRE ops). Will post final status here once p99 stabilizes.
